missions.name: Inventory Imbalance Detection
missions.query: SELECT sku, location, stock_count, reorder_point FROM inventory WHERE stock_count < reorder_point OR stock_count > 10 * reorder_point

missions.name: Sales Data Integrity
missions.query: SELECT transaction_id, date, customer_id, shop_name, product, category, quantity, price, discount_pct, cost, profit FROM shop_sales WHERE price > retail_price OR discount_pct > 50

missions.name: Product Pricing Anomaly
missions.query: SELECT sku, retail_price, unit_cost FROM products WHERE retail_price < unit_cost OR retail_price > 2 * unit_cost

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Analysis
missions.query: SELECT supplier_id, created_at, last_restocked_at FROM products WHERE created_at < last_restocked_at + INTERVAL 30 DAY

missions.name: Inventory Obsolescence Detection
missions.query: SELECT sku, style_name, category, size, color FROM products WHERE created_at < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 1 YEAR

missions.name: Shop Sales Comparison
missions.query: SELECT shop_name, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM shop_sales GROUP BY shop_name HAVING total_quantity < (SELECT AVG(total_quantity) FROM shop_sales)

missions.name: Product Category Profitability Analysis
missions.query: SELECT category, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM shop_sales GROUP BY category HAVING total_profit < (SELECT AVG(total_profit) FROM shop_sales)

missions.name: Payment Method Distribution Analysis
missions.query: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM shop_sales GROUP BY payment_method HAVING frequency < (SELECT AVG(frequency) FROM shop_sales)
